```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

Resources I used: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61987917/how-do-i-replace-k-and-m-with-thousands-and-millions

```{r}
storms <- read_csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv")
```

```{r}
#wrangling for damage visualizations

damages_numeric <- storms |>
 separate(DAMAGE_PROPERTY,into = c("value","modifier"),
           sep = "(?<=[\\d])(?=[^\\d.])") |>
  mutate(modifier = case_when(
                              modifier == "M" ~ 1000000,
                              modifier == "K" ~ 1000,
                              TRUE ~ 1),
         result_property= as.numeric(value) * modifier) |>
  separate(DAMAGE_CROPS,into = c("value","modifier"),
           sep = "(?<=[\\d])(?=[^\\d.])") |>
  mutate(modifier = case_when(
                              modifier == "M" ~ 1000000,
                              modifier == "K" ~ 1000,
                              TRUE ~ 1),
         result_crops= as.numeric(value) * modifier)



damages <- damages_numeric |>
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE, STATE, YEAR) |>
  summarize(
    total_property = sum(result_property),
    total_crops = sum(result_crops),
    per_month_property = total_property/12,
    per_month_crops = total_crops/12
  )

write_csv(damages, "../data/damages.csv")

```

```{r}
#wrangling for storm type

storm_type_state <- storms |>
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE, STATE, YEAR) |>
  summarize(
    N = n()
  )

storm_type_per_year <- storms |>
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE, YEAR) |>
  summarize(
    N = n()
  )

write_csv(storm_type_state, "../data/storm_type_state.csv")
write_csv(storm_type_per_year, "../data/storm_type_year.csv")


```

```{r}
#tornado info

tornado_state <- storms |>
  filter(EVENT_TYPE == "Tornado") |>
  group_by(STATE, YEAR) |>
  summarize(
    length = mean(TOR_LENGTH), 
    width = mean(TOR_WIDTH),
  )

tornado_year <- storms |>
  filter(EVENT_TYPE == "Tornado") |>
  group_by(YEAR) |>
  summarize(
    length = mean(TOR_LENGTH),
    width = mean(TOR_WIDTH)
  )

write_csv(tornado_state, "../data/tornado_state.csv")
write_csv(tornado_year, "../data/tornado_year.csv")


```
